method: Opened the second post image in Chrome and read document.getAnimations() effect timing/keyframes and viewer DOM. Repeated after closing. No local project browser or build validation.

observed.clipPath: Stage transitions from a source-sized inset with rounded corners to inset(0 round 16px).
observed.previews: Each viewer image contains a preview image underneath a separate original image.
observed.farSlides: Some far slides initially use opacity-only entrance; a later opening also exposed geometry transitions for those slides.

interpretation: The fan-out comes from source-thumbnail-sized image geometry travelling to slide destinations concurrently, staggered by distance from the selected image; it is not a small translation around the final position.

localAdaptation.previewSource: Reuse only already-loaded source thumbnails; do not preload extra originals or wait for image decode.
localAdaptation.geometry: Measure clicked thumbnail before opening, measure mounted side endpoints once, derive translate/scale/inset for native snapshots.
localAdaptation.fallback: Browsers without native View Transitions retain the existing small CSS entrance; reduced motion shows endpoints directly.
localAdaptation.validation: Reference interaction observed. Local code changed but not built, tested, or browser-verified.
